items.title: Columbia's first flight
items.line: STS-1 launched on 12 April 1981 with John Young and Robert Crippen and landed at Edwards Air Force Base two days and six hours later, the first Space Shuttle mission.

items.title: Raiders of the Lost Ark
items.line: Spielberg's $20 million adventure with Harrison Ford as Indiana Jones opened on 12 June 1981.

items.title: Donkey Kong
items.line: Nintendo put Shigeru Miyamoto's game out in Japan on 9 July 1981 and North America that October, with a carpenter called Jumpman who later became Mario.

items.title: The royal wedding
items.line: Prince Charles married Lady Diana Spencer at St Paul's Cathedral on 29 July 1981, in front of an estimated TV audience of 750 million.

items.title: MTV
items.line: MTV went on air at 12:01 a.m. on 1 August 1981 and played the Buggles' 'Video Killed the Radio Star' first.

items.title: IBM PC
items.line: IBM launched its Personal Computer on 12 August 1981 from $1,565, with a 4.77 MHz Intel 8088 and 16 KB of memory.
